nodes.title: Enforce managed-Node eligibility for Metrics exporters

description:
Metrics enables exporters only on eligible managed Nodes, including managed Nodes without roles. Ineligible records cannot acquire Gateway service management through an exporter preference.

## Scope

* In: exporter eligibility, enable-request validation, persisted preference interpretation, fleet projection, convergence, Doctor expectations, and Metrics guidance.
* Out: client enrollment or platform expansion, converting clients into managed Nodes, Grafana access, credential lifecycle, and harness changes.

## Acceptance

- [ ] An active Ubuntu 26.04 Node managed by the Gateway over SSH remains eligible; a managed Node without roles can opt in explicitly. Inactive, unsupported-platform, and non-managed policy fixtures remain excluded with absent, enabled, or disabled stored preference. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Unit/Domain/Metrics/ExporterSelectorTest.php` and `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Infrastructure/Metrics/NativeMetricsExporterProjectionTest.php`.
- [ ] Enabling an exporter for an ineligible record returns a bounded refusal before preference mutation or any SSH or remote command attempt; a stored enabled preference cannot bypass eligibility or select the record for scraping. Proof: Gateway Metrics API tests with ineligible fixtures and assertions that no remote operation runs.
- [ ] Fleet reconciliation does not install, configure, start, or require an exporter on a non-managed policy fixture; that fixture cannot block eligible managed-Node convergence. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Infrastructure/Metrics/NativeMetricsExporterLifecycleTest.php` with transport spies.
- [ ] Doctor reports neither missing exporter nor missing exporter SSH as drift for a non-managed policy fixture, preserves managed-Node exporter findings, and makes no changes. Temporary SSH failure on a managed Node remains a managed-Node observation failure rather than changing its eligibility. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/NodeDoctorProbeTest.php` and the Metrics Doctor suites.
- [ ] A supported managed Node without roles can enable its exporter, appears in the Metrics projection, and produces host metrics; disabling it removes its selection. Proof: Incus action `managed-roleless-exporter-lifecycle` on the existing Ubuntu 26.04 topology.
- [ ] Existing role and Metrics-Node defaults, explicit disable behavior, and retry semantics remain valid within the eligible managed fleet. Proof: the Gateway Metrics selector and lifecycle suites.
- [ ] Metrics guidance explains supported managed-Node eligibility without promising client enrollment or another supported platform, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Gateway checks pass. Proof: `cd apps/gateway && composer check`.
